Title: Private Preview: Upgrade existing Azure Gen1 VMs to Gen2-Trusted launch

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce preview support to enable Trusted launch on existing Azure Gen1 VMs by upgrading the Gen1 VM to Gen2-Trusted launch. This will help improve the foundational security of existing Azure VMs.

Trusted Launch VMs provide foundational compute security to Azure Generation 2 VMs by enabling Secure Boot and vTPM capabilities. Trusted Launch capabilities protects OS against rootkits, boot kits and enables attestation by measuring the boot chain of VM.

Fill in the onboarding form for enrolling your Azure subscriptions to the private preview.
